name: Asset Image Scraper
description: Headless service that renders the final image of each personalized kit (output of the Kit Customization Widget) via Puppeteer, and persists it as an optimized product image — instead of re-rendering the canvas on every visit.
descriptionHtml: Headless service that renders the final image of each personalized kit (output of the Kit Customization Widget) via Puppeteer, and persists it as an optimized product image — instead of re-rendering the canvas on every visit.

longDescription.problem: Each personalized kit combination was rendered on the customer's canvas, but the store needed a real, persistent product image (for catalog, cart, checkout, emails) without re-rendering the canvas every time.
longDescription.approach: Built a headless Node.js/TypeScript service using Puppeteer to spin up a browser pool, load the kit configuration, render the canvas, and capture the result as an optimized screenshot. Implemented smart caching to avoid re-rendering already-generated combinations and Docker-based deployment on Azure.
longDescription.outcome: The service reliably generates final kit product images at scale, avoiding client-side canvas re-renders. Deployed on Azure with Docker, it enabled persistent, reusable product images for catalog, cart, checkout, and email.

name: Kit Customization Widget
description: Interactive kit configurator for Shopify football stores — customers combine kit, player, league, patches, name and number, with a real-time canvas preview before purchase.
descriptionHtml: Interactive kit configurator for Shopify football stores — customers combine kit, player, league, patches, name and squad number, with a real-time canvas preview before purchase.

longDescription.problem: Football kit stores needed customers to build their own personalized kit (jersey + player + league + patches + name and number) directly in the Shopify storefront, with a visual preview before purchase.
longDescription.approach: Built a vanilla JavaScript widget embedded in a Shopify theme section. Used the HTML5 Canvas API for real-time rendering of curved text, custom fonts, and kit/patch combinations. Integrated Shopify's GraphQL Storefront API for live inventory checks per variant combination.
longDescription.outcome: Delivered a fully functional customization widget integrated into the client's live Shopify store. Customers can preview personalized kits in real time, reducing back-and-forth with the client and improving conversion on custom orders.

name: Shopify Ecommerce Support & Maintenance
description: Ongoing freelance support and maintenance for Shopify stores — theme fixes, incident resolution, and a full Dawn-to-Horizon theme migration for a professional sports team's ecommerce store.
descriptionHtml: Ongoing freelance support and maintenance for Shopify stores — theme fixes, incident resolution, and a full Dawn-to-Horizon theme migration for a professional sports team's ecommerce store.

longDescription.problem: A live Shopify store needed continuous maintenance — theme bugs, checkout/inventory incidents, and feature adjustments — without a full-time developer on staff. Separately, the store's legacy Dawn-based theme needed a full migration to Shopify's newer Horizon theme.
longDescription.approach: Ongoing on-demand freelance work: diagnosing and resolving storefront incidents, Liquid theme adjustments, and small features. As part of this engagement, led a full theme migration from Shopify Dawn to Horizon — porting a custom kit personalization widget (canvas rendering, fonts, event handling) to Horizon's Web Components model, rebuilding the variant selector from a flat model to an options-based one with swatches, and fixing several Horizon-native bugs (duplicate cart lines, broken search button state) along the way.
longDescription.outcome: Delivered continuous, reliable support with fast incident turnaround, plus a completed theme migration that moved the store onto Shopify's current-generation architecture without disrupting the live customization widget customers depend on.
